            function syncFavoriteInputs() {
                if (favoriteUrlInput) {
                    favoriteUrlInput.value = streamUrlInput ? streamUrlInput.value : '';
                }
                if (favoriteCountryInput && countrySelect) {
                    favoriteCountryInput.value = countrySelect.value || '';
                }
                if (favoriteNameInput && channelSelect) {
                    var selectedOption = channelSelect.options[channelSelect.selectedIndex];
                    favoriteNameInput.value = selectedOption ? selectedOption.text : '';
                }
            }

            function rebuildChannelSelect(countryCode, keepCurrentUrl) {
                if (!channelSelect) {
                    return;
                }
                var channels = countryChannels[countryCode] || [];
                var currentUrl = keepCurrentUrl ? streamUrlInput.value.trim() : '';
                channelSelect.innerHTML = '';

                if (channels.length === 0) {
                    var emptyOption = document.createElement('option');
                    emptyOption.value = '';
                    emptyOption.textContent = 'Keine Sender verfuegbar';
                    channelSelect.appendChild(emptyOption);
                    return;
                }

                var selectedUrl = '';
                channels.forEach(function (channel, index) {
                    var option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = channel.url;
                    option.textContent = channel.name;
                    if (currentUrl !== '' && currentUrl === channel.url) {
                        option.selected = true;
                        selectedUrl = channel.url;
                    } else if (selectedUrl === '' && index === 0) {
                        option.selected = true;
                        selectedUrl = channel.url;
                    }
                    channelSelect.appendChild(option);
                });

                if (selectedUrl !== '' && (!keepCurrentUrl || streamUrlInput.value.trim() === '')) {
                    streamUrlInput.value = selectedUrl;
                }
                syncFavoriteInputs();
            }

            function setRecordButtons(state) {
                if (state === 'idle') {
                    recordStart.disabled = false;
                    recordPause.disabled = true;
                    recordResume.disabled = true;
                    recordStop.disabled = true;
                } else if (state === 'recording') {
                    recordStart.disabled = true;
                    recordPause.disabled = false;
                    recordResume.disabled = true;
                    recordStop.disabled = false;
                } else if (state === 'paused') {
                    recordStart.disabled = true;
                    recordPause.disabled = true;
                    recordResume.disabled = false;
                    recordStop.disabled = false;
                }
            }

            function updateTimerLabel() {
                var minutes = String(Math.floor(timerSeconds / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
                var seconds = String(timerSeconds % 60).padStart(2, '0');
                recordTimer.textContent = minutes + ':' + seconds;
            }

            function startTimer() {
                stopTimer();
                timerInterval = window.setInterval(function () {
                    timerSeconds += 1;
                    updateTimerLabel();
                }, 1000);
            }

            function stopTimer() {
                if (timerInterval) {
                    window.clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    timerInterval = null;
                }
            }

            function resetTimer() {
                timerSeconds = 0;
                updateTimerLabel();
            }

            function setDownload(blob, ext) {
                if (lastObjectUrl) {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(lastObjectUrl);
                }
                lastObjectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                var now = new Date();
                var timestamp = [
                    now.getFullYear(),
                    String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')
                ].join('-');
                var countryPrefix = getCountryFilePrefix();
                var safeName = [
                    countryPrefix,
                    'Aufzeichnung',
                    timestamp
                ].join('-');
                recordDownload.href = lastObjectUrl;
                recordDownload.download = safeName + '.' + ext;
                recordDownload.classList.remove('disabled');
                recordDownload.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'false');
            }

            function getCountryFilePrefix() {
                var rawCountry = '';
                if (countrySelect && countrySelect.value) {
                    rawCountry = countrySelect.value;
                } else if (selectedCountryName) {
                    rawCountry = selectedCountryName;
                }
                var normalized = String(rawCountry || 'UNBEKANNT')
                    .replace(/\s+/g, '_')
                    .replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, '')
                    .toUpperCase();
                return normalized || 'UNBEKANNT';
            }

            function getCurrentCountryForTranscript() {
                if (countrySelect && countrySelect.value) {
                    return countrySelect.value;
                }
                if (serverChannelSelect && serverChannelSelect.selectedIndex >= 0) {
                    var serverOption = serverChannelSelect.options[serverChannelSelect.selectedIndex];
                    var serverLabel = serverOption ? String(serverOption.text || '') : '';
                    var match = serverLabel.match(/^\[([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\]/);
                    if (match) {
                        return match[1].toUpperCase();
                    }
                }
                if (selectedCountryName) {
                    return selectedCountryName;
                }
                return 'UNBEKANNT';
            }

            function getCurrentChannelForTranscript() {
                var currentUrl = streamUrlInput ? String(streamUrlInput.value || '').trim() : '';
                var selectedOption = null;
                var i = 0;

                if (channelSelect && channelSelect.options) {
                    for (i = 0; i < channelSelect.options.length; i += 1) {
                        if (channelSelect.options[i].value === currentUrl) {
                            selectedOption = channelSelect.options[i];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!selectedOption && channelSelect.selectedIndex >= 0) {
                        selectedOption = channelSelect.options[channelSelect.selectedIndex];
                    }
                }

                if (!selectedOption && serverChannelSelect && serverChannelSelect.options) {
                    for (i = 0; i < serverChannelSelect.options.length; i += 1) {
                        if (serverChannelSelect.options[i].value === currentUrl) {
                            selectedOption = serverChannelSelect.options[i];
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (!selectedOption && serverChannelSelect.selectedIndex >= 0) {
                        selectedOption = serverChannelSelect.options[serverChannelSelect.selectedIndex];
                    }
                }

                if (selectedOption && selectedOption.text) {
                    return String(selectedOption.text)
                        .replace(/^\[[^\]]+\]\s*/, '')
                        .trim();
                }

                if (currentUrl !== '') {
                    try {
                        return new URL(currentUrl).host || 'STREAM';
                    } catch (err) {
                        return currentUrl;
                    }
                }

                return 'STREAM';
            }

            function pickRecorderType() {
                if (!window.MediaRecorder) {
                    return null;
                }
                var candidates = [
                    'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2',
                    'video/mp4',
                    'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus',
                    'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
                    'video/webm'
                ];
                for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i += 1) {
                    if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(candidates[i])) {
                        return candidates[i];
                    }
                }
                return '';
            }

            function appendLiveSubtitle(text) {

                if (placeholder) {

                translateLive.appendChild(line);
                translateLive.scrollTop = translateLive.scrollHeight;
            }

            function getLanguageDisplayName(code, fallback) {
                var normalized = String(code || '').trim().toLowerCase();
                if (!normalized) {
                    return fallback || '';
                }

                if (languageDisplayNames) {
                    try {
                        var displayName = languageDisplayNames.of(normalized);
                        if (displayName) {
                            return displayName;
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        // Fall back to code below.
                    }
                }

                return String(fallback || code || '').trim().toUpperCase();
            }

            function updateTranslationHeader() {
                if (!translateHeading || !translateCountdown) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!translationActive) {
                    translateHeading.textContent = 'Transscript';
                    translateHeading.classList.remove('is-running');
                    if (translateDirection) {
                        translateDirection.textContent = '';
                        translateDirection.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                    translateCountdown.textContent = '';
                    translateCountdown.classList.remove('is-visible');
                    return;
                }

                translateHeading.textContent = 'Uebersetzung gestartet';
                translateHeading.classList.add('is-running');
                if (translateDirection) {
                    var countryLabel = transcriptSessionCountry || getCurrentCountryForTranscript();
                    var sourceLabel = getLanguageDisplayName(translationDetectedSourceLang, 'Detecting...');
                    var targetLabel = getLanguageDisplayName(translateTarget.value, 'German');
                    translateDirection.textContent = countryLabel + ': ' + sourceLabel + ' => ' + targetLabel;
                    translateDirection.classList.remove('d-none');
                }

                var remainingSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((translationNextChunkAt - Date.now()) / 1000));
                translateCountdown.textContent = 'Naechste in ' + remainingSeconds + ' s';
                translateCountdown.classList.add('is-visible');
            }

            function stopTranslationCountdown() {
                translationNextChunkAt = 0;
                if (translationCountdownInterval) {
                    window.clearInterval(translationCountdownInterval);
                    translationCountdownInterval = null;
                }
                updateTranslationHeader();
            }

            function startTranslationCountdown() {
                translationNextChunkAt = Date.now() + translationChunkDurationMs;
                if (!translationCountdownInterval) {
                    translationCountdownInterval = window.setInterval(function () {
                        updateTranslationHeader();
                    }, 250);
                }
                updateTranslationHeader();
            }

            function escapeHtml(value) {
                return String(value)
                    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
                    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
                    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
                    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
                    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
            }

            function sanitizeM3uField(value, fallback) {
                var text = String(value || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').replace(/"/g, '\'').trim();
                return text !== '' ? text : fallback;
            }

            function normalizeFavoriteItem(item) {
                if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
                    return null;
                }
                var url = String(item.url || '').trim();
                if (!url) {
                    return null;
                }
                try {
                    var parsed = new URL(url, window.location.href);
                    if (!/^https?:$/i.test(parsed.protocol)) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    url = parsed.href;
                } catch (err) {
                    return null;
                }

                var country = String(item.country || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                if (!country) {
                    country = 'UNBEKANNT';
                }

                var name = String(item.name || '').trim();
                if (!name) {
                    try {
                        name = new URL(url).hostname || 'Sender';
                    } catch (err) {
                        name = 'Sender';
                    }
                }

                return {
                    url: url,
                    country: country,
                    name: name,
                };
            }

            function readStoredFavorites() {
                try {
                    var raw = localStorage.getItem(favoriteStorageKey);
                    if (!raw) {
                        return [];
                    }
                    var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
                    if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) {
                        return [];
                    }
                    var normalized = [];
                    var seen = {};
                    parsed.forEach(function (item) {
                        var favorite = normalizeFavoriteItem(item);
                        if (!favorite || seen[favorite.url]) {
                            return;
                        }
                        seen[favorite.url] = true;
                        normalized.push(favorite);
                    });
                    return normalized;
                } catch (err) {
                    return [];
                }
            }

            function sortFavorites(items) {
                items.sort(function (a, b) {
                    var countryCmp = a.country.localeCompare(b.country, 'de', { sensitivity: 'base' });
                    if (countryCmp !== 0) {
                        return countryCmp;
                    }
                    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'de', { sensitivity: 'base' });
                });
                return items;
            }

            function writeStoredFavorites(items) {
                try {
                    localStorage.setItem(favoriteStorageKey, JSON.stringify(items));
                } catch (err) {
                    // ignore storage errors
                }
            }

            function getClientFavorites() {
                return sortFavorites(readStoredFavorites());
            }

            function setClientFavorites(items) {
                writeStoredFavorites(sortFavorites(items));
                renderFavorites();
            }

            function migrateLegacyFavoritesIfNeeded() {
                var current = readStoredFavorites();
                if (current.length > 0) {
                    return;
                }
                if (!Array.isArray(legacyFavoritesData) || legacyFavoritesData.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                var migrated = [];
                var seen = {};
                legacyFavoritesData.forEach(function (item) {
                    var favorite = normalizeFavoriteItem(item);
                    if (!favorite || seen[favorite.url]) {
                        return;
                    }
                    seen[favorite.url] = true;
                    migrated.push(favorite);
                });
                if (migrated.length > 0) {
                    writeStoredFavorites(sortFavorites(migrated));
                }
            }

            function getPlayUrl(url) {
                return window.location.pathname + '?play=' + encodeURIComponent(url);
            }

            function renderFavorites() {
                if (!favoritesList || !favoritesEmpty) {
                    return;
                }
                var items = getClientFavorites();
                if (items.length === 0) {
                    favoritesList.innerHTML = '';
                    favoritesEmpty.classList.remove('d-none');
                    if (downloadFavoritesM3uBtn) {
                        downloadFavoritesM3uBtn.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                } else {
                    favoritesEmpty.classList.add('d-none');
                    if (downloadFavoritesM3uBtn) {
                        downloadFavoritesM3uBtn.classList.remove('d-none');
                    }
                    var html = items.map(function (item) {
                        var label = '[' + escapeHtml(item.country) + '] ' + escapeHtml(item.name);
                        var playUrl = getPlayUrl(item.url);
                        return ''
                            + '<div class="list-group-item d-flex flex-column flex-md-row gap-2 align-items-md-center justify-content-between">'
                            + '<span class="text-truncate pe-3 flex-grow-1">' + label + '</span>'
                            + '<div class="d-flex gap-2 align-items-center">'
                            + '<a class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" href="' + escapeHtml(playUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Im neuen Tab</a>'
                            + '<a class="btn btn-sm btn-warning" href="' + escapeHtml(playUrl) + '">Abspielen</a>'
                            + '<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger favorite-delete-btn" data-url="' + escapeHtml(item.url) + '" title="Loeschen">Trashbin</button>'
                            + '</div></div>';
                    }).join('');
                    favoritesList.innerHTML = html;
                }

                if (serverFavoritesJson) {
                    serverFavoritesJson.value = JSON.stringify(items);
                }
            }

            function updateTranscriptButtonState() {
                var hasEntries = transcriptSessionEntries.length > 0;
                downloadTransscriptBtn.disabled = !hasEntries;
                downloadTransscriptBtn.classList.toggle('d-none', !hasEntries);
            }

            function buildTranscriptWordHtml() {
                var title = 'Transscript Session';
                var sessionStart = transcriptSessionStartedAt
                    ? transcriptSessionStartedAt.toLocaleString()
                    : new Date().toLocaleString();
                var sourceLanguageLabel = getLanguageDisplayName(translationDetectedSourceLang, 'Detected language');
                var targetLanguageLabel = getLanguageDisplayName(translateTarget.value, 'German');
                var rows = transcriptSessionEntries.map(function (entry, index) {
                    return '<tr>'
                        + '<td>' + (index + 1) + '</td>'
                        + '<td>' + escapeHtml(entry.original) + '</td>'
                        + '<td>' + escapeHtml(entry.translated) + '</td>'
                        + '</tr>';
                }).join('');
                var headerCountry = transcriptSessionEntries.length > 0 ? transcriptSessionEntries[0].country : '';
                var headerChannel = transcriptSessionEntries.length > 0 ? transcriptSessionEntries[0].channel : '';
                var headerTimeGmt = transcriptSessionEntries.length > 0 ? transcriptSessionEntries[0].timeGmt : new Date().toUTCString();

                return ''
                    + '<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>' + escapeHtml(title) + '</title></head><body>'
                    + '<h1>' + escapeHtml(title) + '</h1>'
                    + '<p>Session-Start: ' + escapeHtml(sessionStart) + '</p>'
                    + '<p>Land: ' + escapeHtml(headerCountry) + '</p>'
                    + '<p>Sender: ' + escapeHtml(headerChannel) + '</p>'
                    + '<p>Zeit (GMT): ' + escapeHtml(headerTimeGmt) + '</p>'
                    + '<table border="1" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="6">'
                    + '<thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Original: ' + escapeHtml(sourceLanguageLabel) + '</th><th>Uebersetzung: ' + escapeHtml(targetLanguageLabel) + '</th></tr></thead>'
                    + '<tbody>' + rows + '</tbody>'
                    + '</table>'
                    + '</body></html>';
            }

            function downloadTranscriptDoc() {
                if (transcriptSessionEntries.length === 0) {
                    return;
                }
                var html = buildTranscriptWordHtml();
                var blob = new Blob(['\ufeff' + html], { type: 'application/msword' });
                var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                var link = document.createElement('a');
                var now = new Date();
                var timestamp = [
                    now.getFullYear(),
                    String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0'),
                    String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')
                ].join('-');
                var countryPrefix = getCountryFilePrefix();
                var fileName = [
                    countryPrefix,
                    'Transskript',
                    timestamp
                ].join('-') + '.doc';
                link.href = url;
                link.download = fileName;
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                }, 1000);
            }

            function pickTranslationMediaType() {
                if (!window.MediaRecorder) {
                    return '';
                }
                var candidates = [
                    'audio/webm;codecs=opus',
                    'audio/webm',
                    'audio/ogg;codecs=opus',
                    'audio/webm'
                ];
                for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i += 1) {
                    if (MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(candidates[i])) {
                        return candidates[i];
                    }
                }
                return '';
            }

            function canUseClientTranslationCapture() {
                var userAgent = navigator.userAgent || '';
                var isFirefox = /firefox/i.test(userAgent);
                if (isFirefox) {
                    return false;
                }
                return !!window.MediaRecorder && !!(video && (video.captureStream || video.mozCaptureStream));
            }

            async function sendTranslationChunk(blob) {
                var formData = new FormData();
                var extension = blob.type.indexOf('mp4') !== -1 ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
                var sourceLang = translateSource.value === 'AUTO' ? '' : translateSource.value;
                formData.append('mode', 'client');
                formData.append('audio', blob, 'stream-chunk.' + extension);
                formData.append('target_lang', (translateTarget.value || 'de').toUpperCase());
                formData.append('source_lang', sourceLang);
                formData.append('session_country', transcriptSessionCountry || getCurrentCountryForTranscript());
                formData.append('session_channel', transcriptSessionChannel || getCurrentChannelForTranscript());
                formData.append(
                    'session_started_at',
                    transcriptSessionStartedAt instanceof Date ? transcriptSessionStartedAt.toISOString() : ''
                );

                var response = await fetch('translate_stream.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData
                });
                var json = null;
                try {
                    json = await response.json();
                } catch (e) {
                    json = null;
                }
                if (!response.ok) {
                    if (json && json.error) {
                        var detailError = json.detail ? (' - ' + json.detail) : '';
                        throw new Error(json.error + detailError);
                    }
                    throw new Error('Backend-Fehler bei der Uebersetzung');
                }
                if (!json || json.ok !== true) {
                    if (json && json.error) {
                        var detailText = json.detail ? (' - ' + json.detail) : '';
                        throw new Error(json.error + detailText);
                    }
                    throw new Error('Uebersetzung fehlgeschlagen');
                }
                return json;
            }

            async function sendServerTranslationRequest() {
                var formData = new FormData();
                var sourceLang = translateSource.value === 'AUTO' ? '' : translateSource.value;
                formData.append('mode', 'server');
                formData.append('stream_url', streamUrl);
                formData.append('chunk_duration', String(Math.round(translationChunkDurationMs / 1000)));
                formData.append('target_lang', (translateTarget.value || 'de').toUpperCase());
                formData.append('source_lang', sourceLang);
                formData.append('session_country', transcriptSessionCountry || getCurrentCountryForTranscript());
                formData.append('session_channel', transcriptSessionChannel || getCurrentChannelForTranscript());
                formData.append(
                    'session_started_at',
                    transcriptSessionStartedAt instanceof Date ? transcriptSessionStartedAt.toISOString() : ''
                );

                var response = await fetch('translate_stream.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: formData
                });
                var json = null;
                try {
                    json = await response.json();
                } catch (e) {
                    json = null;
                }
                if (!response.ok) {
                    if (json && json.error) {
                        var detailError = json.detail ? (' - ' + json.detail) : '';
                        throw new Error(json.error + detailError);
                    }
                    throw new Error('Backend-Fehler bei der Uebersetzung');
                }
                if (!json || json.ok !== true) {
                    if (json && json.error) {
                        var detailText = json.detail ? (' - ' + json.detail) : '';
                        throw new Error(json.error + detailText);
                    }
                    throw new Error('Uebersetzung fehlgeschlagen');
                }
                return json;
            }

            function stopTranslationRecorder() {
                if (translationRecorder && translationRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
                    translationRecorder.stop();
                }
                translationRecorder = null;

                if (translationMediaStream) {
                    translationMediaStream.getTracks().forEach(function (track) {
                        track.stop();
                    });
                    translationMediaStream = null;
                }

                if (translationWatchdog) {
                    window.clearInterval(translationWatchdog);
                    translationWatchdog = null;
                }
                if (translationCycleTimer) {
                    window.clearTimeout(translationCycleTimer);
                    translationCycleTimer = null;
                }
                stopTranslationCountdown();
            }

            function handleTranslationResult(result) {
                var translated = (result.translated_text || '').trim();
                var original = (result.text || '').trim();
                translationDetectedSourceLang = (result.detected_source_language || '').trim().toUpperCase();
                updateTranslationHeader();
                if (translated !== '') {
                    showSubtitle(translated);
                    appendLiveSubtitle(translated);
                    setTranslationStatus('Uebersetzung aktiv (' + getLanguageDisplayName(translateTarget.value, 'German') + ').');
                } else if (original !== '') {
                    showSubtitle(original);
                    appendLiveSubtitle(original);
                    setTranslationStatus('Transkript empfangen, keine Uebersetzung zurueckgegeben.');
                }
                if (original !== '' || translated !== '') {
                    var countryValue = transcriptSessionCountry || getCurrentCountryForTranscript();
                    var channelValue = transcriptSessionChannel || getCurrentChannelForTranscript();
                    transcriptSessionEntries.push({
                        timeGmt: new Date().toUTCString(),
                        country: countryValue,
                        channel: channelValue,
                        original: original,
                        translated: translated
                    });
                    updateTranscriptButtonState();
                }
            }

            function processTranslationQueue() {
                if (translationQueueBusy || !translationActive) {
                    return;
                }
                translationQueueBusy = true;

                (async function () {
                    while (translationActive && translationQueue.length > 0) {
                        var chunk = translationQueue.shift();
                        try {
                            var result = await sendTranslationChunk(chunk);
                            handleTranslationResult(result);
                        } catch (err) {
                            var errMsg = (err && err.message ? err.message : 'Unbekannter Fehler');
                            setTranslationStatus('Uebersetzung fehlgeschlagen: ' + errMsg);
                            if (errMsg.toLowerCase().indexOf('exceeded your current quota') !== -1) {
                                translateToggle.checked = false;
                                stopTranslation();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                })().finally(function () {
                    translationQueueBusy = false;
                    if (translationActive && translationQueue.length > 0) {
                        processTranslationQueue();
                    }
                });
            }

            function startServerTranslationLoop() {
                if (translationQueueBusy || !translationActive) {
                    return;
                }
                translationQueueBusy = true;

                (async function () {
                    while (translationActive) {
                        try {
                            startTranslationCountdown();
                            setTranslationStatus('Server-Fallback aktiv. Audio wird direkt vom Stream geholt ...');
                            var result = await sendServerTranslationRequest();
                            if (!translationActive) {
                                return;
                            }
                            translationChunkCount += 1;
                            handleTranslationResult(result);
                        } catch (err) {
                            var errMsg = (err && err.message ? err.message : 'Unbekannter Fehler');
                            setTranslationStatus('Server-Fallback fehlgeschlagen: ' + errMsg);
                            translateToggle.checked = false;
                            stopTranslation();
                            return;
                        }
                    }
                })().finally(function () {
                    translationQueueBusy = false;
                });
            }

            function stopTranslation() {
                translationActive = false;
                translationQueue = [];
                translationChunkCount = 0;
                stopTranslationRecorder();
                showSubtitle('');
                setTranslationStatus('Uebersetzung aus. Bei AN wird Stream-Audio verarbeitet (OpenAI + DeepL).');
                updateTranslationHeader();
            }

            async function startTranslation() {
                if (!streamUrl) {
                    translateToggle.checked = false;
                    setTranslationStatus('Bitte zuerst einen Stream starten.');
                    return;
                }
                translationMode = canUseClientTranslationCapture() ? 'client' : 'server';

                if (translationMode === 'client') {
                    if (video.paused || video.readyState < 2) {
                        try {
                            await video.play();
                        } catch (err) {
                            translateToggle.checked = false;
                            setTranslationStatus('Wiedergabe blockiert. Bitte zuerst auf Play im Video klicken.');
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    var streamCapture = await waitForCaptureStream(4000);
                    if (!streamCapture || streamCapture.getTracks().length === 0) {
                        translateToggle.checked = false;
                        setTranslationStatus('Kein aufnehmbarer Track im Stream gefunden. Pruefe Browser/CORS des Senders.');
                        return;
                    }

                    var audioTracks = streamCapture.getAudioTracks();
                    if (!audioTracks || audioTracks.length === 0) {
                        translateToggle.checked = false;
                        setTranslationStatus('Der Stream hat keinen Audio-Track fuer Transkription.');
                        return;
                    }
                    translationMediaStream = new MediaStream(audioTracks);
                    translationMimeType = pickTranslationMediaType();
                }

                translationActive = true;
                translationQueue = [];
                translationChunkCount = 0;
                translationStartedAt = Date.now();
                translationDetectedSourceLang = '';
                transcriptSessionEntries = [];
                transcriptSessionStartedAt = new Date();
                transcriptSessionCountry = getCurrentCountryForTranscript();
                transcriptSessionChannel = getCurrentChannelForTranscript();
                updateTranscriptButtonState();
                resetLiveSubtitleLog();
                setTranslationStatus(
                    translationMode === 'client'
                        ? 'Uebersetzung aktiv. Audio-Chunks werden an OpenAI + DeepL gesendet.'
                        : 'Server-Fallback aktiv. Audio wird direkt vom Stream geholt.'
                );
                showSubtitle('Uebersetzung gestartet ...');
                updateTranslationHeader();

                if (translationMode === 'server') {
                    startServerTranslationLoop();
                    return;
                }

                function runCycle() {
                    if (!translationActive) {
                        return;
                    }

                    var cycleChunks = [];
                    try {
                        translationRecorder = translationMimeType
                            ? new MediaRecorder(translationMediaStream, { mimeType: translationMimeType })
                            : new MediaRecorder(translationMediaStream);
                    } catch (err) {
                        setTranslationStatus('Recorder fuer Uebersetzung konnte nicht gestartet werden.');
                        translateToggle.checked = false;
                        stopTranslation();
                        return;
                    }

                    translationRecorder.ondataavailable = function (event) {
                        if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
                            cycleChunks.push(event.data);
                        }
                    };

                    translationRecorder.onerror = function () {
                        setTranslationStatus('Recorder-Fehler bei der Stream-Uebersetzung.');
                    };

                    translationRecorder.onstop = function () {
                        if (!translationActive) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (cycleChunks.length > 0) {
                            var chunkBlob = new Blob(cycleChunks, { type: translationMimeType || 'audio/webm' });
                            if (chunkBlob.size < translationMinChunkBytes) {
                                setTranslationStatus(
                                    'Kein verwertbares Audio fuer die Uebersetzung erkannt. '
                                    + 'Der Browser liefert nur einen ungueltigen Mini-Chunk ('
                                    + chunkBlob.size + ' Bytes).'
                                );
                                translateToggle.checked = false;
                                stopTranslation();
                                return;
                            }
                            translationChunkCount += 1;
                            setTranslationStatus('Uebersetzung aktiv. Chunk #' + translationChunkCount + ' wird verarbeitet ...');
                            translationQueue.push(chunkBlob);
                            processTranslationQueue();
                        }
                        runCycle();
                    };

                    translationRecorder.start();
                    startTranslationCountdown();
                    translationCycleTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                        if (translationRecorder && translationRecorder.state === 'recording') {
                            translationRecorder.stop();
                        }
                    }, translationChunkDurationMs);
                }

                runCycle();
                translationWatchdog = window.setInterval(function () {
                    if (!translationActive) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (translationChunkCount === 0 && Date.now() - translationStartedAt > 20000) {
                        setTranslationStatus(
                            'Noch keine Chunks empfangen. Pruefe Audio im Stream, Browserrechte und CORS.'
                        );
                    }
                }, 3000);
            }

            function initStreamPlayback() {
                if (!streamUrl) {
                    playerMessage.textContent = 'Bitte eine Stream-URL eingeben.';
                    return;
                }

                if (playerShell) {
                    window.setTimeout(function () {
                        var top = playerShell.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 12;
                        window.scrollTo({
                            top: Math.max(0, top),
                            behavior: 'smooth'
                        });
                    }, 50);
                }

                playerMessage.textContent = '';
                function attemptStreamPlay() {
                    var playPromise = video.play();
                    if (playPromise && typeof playPromise.then === 'function') {
                        playPromise.then(function () {
                            playerMessage.textContent = '';
                        }).catch(function () {
                            playerMessage.textContent = 'Autoplay blockiert. Bitte im Video auf Play klicken.';
                        });
                    }
                }

                if (hlsPlayer) {
                    hlsPlayer.destroy();
                    hlsPlayer = null;
                }

                if (window.Hls && Hls.isSupported()) {
                    hlsPlayer = new Hls();
                    hlsPlayer.loadSource(streamUrl);
                    hlsPlayer.attachMedia(video);
                    hlsPlayer.on(Hls.Events.MANIFEST_PARSED, function () {
                        attemptStreamPlay();
                    });
                } else if (video.canPlayType('application/vnd.apple.mpegurl')) {
                    video.src = streamUrl;
                    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', function () {
                        attemptStreamPlay();
                    }, { once: true });
                } else {
                    playerMessage.textContent = 'Dieser Browser unterstuetzt HLS (.m3u8) nicht.';
                }
            }

            function prepareRecorder() {
                if (!window.MediaRecorder) {
                    recordStart.disabled = true;
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Recorder wird von diesem Browser nicht unterstuetzt.';
                    return false;
                }
                recordMimeType = pickRecorderType() || '';
                recordExt = recordMimeType.indexOf('mp4') !== -1 ? 'mp4' : 'webm';
                if (recordExt !== 'mp4') {
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'MP4-Aufnahme nicht verfuegbar, Browser nutzt WEBM-Fallback.';
                }
                return true;
            }

            function getMediaCaptureStream() {
                try {
                    if (video.captureStream) {
                        return video.captureStream();
                    }
                    if (video.mozCaptureStream) {
                        return video.mozCaptureStream();
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    return null;
                }
                return null;
            }

            function waitForCaptureStream(timeoutMs) {
                var pollMs = 200;
                var startedAt = Date.now();

                return new Promise(function (resolve) {
                    function probe() {
                        var current = getMediaCaptureStream();
                        if (current && current.getTracks().length > 0) {
                            resolve(current);
                            return;
                        }
                        if (Date.now() - startedAt >= timeoutMs) {
                            resolve(null);
                            return;
                        }
                        window.setTimeout(probe, pollMs);
                    }
                    probe();
                });
            }

            recordStart.addEventListener('click', async function () {
                if (!prepareRecorder()) {
                    return;
                }

                if (video.paused || video.readyState < 2) {
                    try {
                        await video.play();
                    } catch (err) {
                        recordStatus.textContent = 'Wiedergabe blockiert. Bitte zuerst auf Play im Video klicken.';
                        return;
                    }
                }

                var captureStream = await waitForCaptureStream(4000);
                if (!captureStream || captureStream.getTracks().length === 0) {
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Kein aktiver Stream-Track gefunden. Pruefe Browser/CORS des Senders.';
                    return;
                }

                recordChunks = [];
                resetTimer();
                startTimer();
                setRecordButtons('recording');
                recordStatus.textContent = 'Aufnahme laeuft...';

                try {
                    recorder = recordMimeType
                        ? new MediaRecorder(captureStream, { mimeType: recordMimeType })
                        : new MediaRecorder(captureStream);
                } catch (err) {
                    stopTimer();
                    setRecordButtons('idle');
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Recorder konnte nicht gestartet werden.';
                    return;
                }

                recorder.ondataavailable = function (event) {
                    if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
                        recordChunks.push(event.data);
                    }
                };

                recorder.onstop = function () {
                    stopTimer();
                    setRecordButtons('idle');
                    if (recordChunks.length === 0) {
                        recordStatus.textContent = 'Keine Daten aufgenommen.';
                        return;
                    }
                    var blobType = recordMimeType || ('video/' + recordExt);
                    var recordingBlob = new Blob(recordChunks, { type: blobType });
                    setDownload(recordingBlob, recordExt);
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Aufnahme gestoppt. Download bereit (' + recordExt.toUpperCase() + ').';
                };

                recorder.start(1000);
            });

            recordPause.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (recorder && recorder.state === 'recording') {
                    recorder.pause();
                    stopTimer();
                    setRecordButtons('paused');
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Aufnahme pausiert.';
                }
            });

            recordResume.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (recorder && recorder.state === 'paused') {
                    recorder.resume();
                    startTimer();
                    setRecordButtons('recording');
                    recordStatus.textContent = 'Aufnahme fortgesetzt.';
                }
            });

            recordStop.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (recorder && (recorder.state === 'recording' || recorder.state === 'paused')) {
                    recorder.stop();
                }
            });

            if (countrySelect) {
                countrySelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    rebuildChannelSelect(countrySelect.value, false);
                    syncFavoriteInputs();
                });
            }
            if (channelSelect) {
                channelSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    if (channelSelect.value) {
                        streamUrlInput.value = channelSelect.value;
                    }
                    syncFavoriteInputs();
                });
            }
            if (serverChannelSelect) {
                serverChannelSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                    if (serverChannelSelect.value) {
                        streamUrlInput.value = serverChannelSelect.value;
                    }
                    syncFavoriteInputs();
                });
            }
            if (streamUrlInput) {
                streamUrlInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    syncFavoriteInputs();
                });
            }

            translateToggle.addEventListener('change', function () {
                if (translateToggle.checked) {
                    startTranslation();
                } else {
                    stopTranslation();
                }
            });

            translateSource.addEventListener('change', function () {
                if (!translationActive) {
                    return;
                }
                stopTranslation();
                translateToggle.checked = true;
                startTranslation();
            });

            translateTarget.addEventListener('change', function () {
                if (!translationActive) {
                    return;
                }
                setTranslationStatus('Zielsprache aktualisiert auf ' + translateTarget.value.toUpperCase() + '.');
            });
            downloadTransscriptBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                downloadTranscriptDoc();
            });

            if (favoriteAddForm) {
                favoriteAddForm.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    var candidate = normalizeFavoriteItem({
                        url: favoriteUrlInput ? favoriteUrlInput.value : '',
                        country: favoriteCountryInput ? favoriteCountryInput.value : '',
                        name: favoriteNameInput ? favoriteNameInput.value : '',
                    });
                    if (!candidate) {
                        window.alert('Keine gueltige URL fuer Favoriten gefunden.');
                        return;
                    }
                    var items = getClientFavorites();
                    var exists = items.some(function (item) {
                        return item.url === candidate.url;
                    });
                    if (!exists) {
                        items.push(candidate);
                        setClientFavorites(items);
                    }
                });
            }

            if (favoritesList) {
                favoritesList.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                    var target = event.target;
                    if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var deleteButton = target.closest('.favorite-delete-btn');
                    if (!deleteButton) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var removeUrl = deleteButton.getAttribute('data-url') || '';
                    if (!removeUrl) {
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!window.confirm('Wirklich loeschen?')) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var nextItems = getClientFavorites().filter(function (item) {
                        return item.url !== removeUrl;
                    });
                    setClientFavorites(nextItems);
                });
            }

            if (serverWriteForm) {
                serverWriteForm.addEventListener('submit', function () {
                    if (serverFavoritesJson) {
                        serverFavoritesJson.value = JSON.stringify(getClientFavorites());
                    }
                });
            }

            if (downloadFavoritesM3uBtn) {
                downloadFavoritesM3uBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    var favoritesExportData = getClientFavorites();
                    if (!Array.isArray(favoritesExportData) || favoritesExportData.length === 0) {
                        return;
                    }
                    var lines = ['#EXTM3U'];
                    favoritesExportData.forEach(function (item) {
                        var country = sanitizeM3uField(item && item.country, 'UNBEKANNT');
                        var url = sanitizeM3uField(item && item.url, '');
                        if (!url) {
                            return;
                        }
                        var senderRaw = sanitizeM3uField(item && item.name, '');
                        if (!senderRaw) {
                            try {
                                senderRaw = sanitizeM3uField(new URL(url).hostname, '');
                            } catch (err) {
                                senderRaw = '';
                            }
                        }
                        var sender = senderRaw || 'Sender';
                        var channelLabel = '[' + country + '] ' + sender;
                        lines.push('#EXTINF:-1 tvg-id="' + channelLabel + '",' + channelLabel);
                        lines.push(url);
                    });
                    var blob = new Blob([lines.join('\n') + '\n'], { type: 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl;charset=utf-8' });
                    var fileUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                    var link = document.createElement('a');
                    link.href = fileUrl;
                    link.download = 'persoenliche-favoritenliste.m3u8';
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(link);
                    window.setTimeout(function () {
                        URL.revokeObjectURL(fileUrl);
                    }, 500);
                });
            }

            if (countrySelect && countrySelect.value) {
                rebuildChannelSelect(countrySelect.value, true);
            }
            migrateLegacyFavoritesIfNeeded();
            renderFavorites();
            syncFavoriteInputs();
            initStreamPlayback();
            setRecordButtons('idle');
            resetTimer();
            if (!streamUrl) {
                recordStart.disabled = true;
            } else {
                prepareRecorder();
            }
            resetLiveSubtitleLog();
            updateTranscriptButtonState();
            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function () {
                if (lastObjectUrl) {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(lastObjectUrl);
                }
                stopTranslation();
            });
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
